task.domain: Games adaptation of HaNoRec hit-1 binary preference
task.candidate_source: frozen SASRec top-M candidates; target never inserted
task.scoring: single answer-token log P(Yes)-log P(No) at the chat generation prefix; no assistant terminator/EOS in the score

llamafactory.note: The pinned HaNoRec requirement exposes a package version but no source commit. The corrected Games runner ports and tests the observable HaNoRec trainer contract; it does not claim byte-identical LLaMA-Factory internals.

sft.target_modules: language-model linear layers (q,k,v,o,gate,up,down); vision tower frozen

dpo.reference: frozen post-SFT adapter, no DPO adapter

controls.shuffle: fixed-point-free frequency-stratified item bijection built from training rows only
controls.constant_hardness: validation-only mean-matched diagnostic; not a primary test arm

smoke.purpose: correctness and measured resource smoke only

invariants: training pair and hardness hashes do not change when held-out targets/candidates/images change
negative is not target, observed history, or train-known future item
shuffle is a bijection and has no fixed points
global responsiveness batch has at least three examples
only the fresh DPO adapter changes during DPO
SFT-only reference is invariant to DPO updates and NoDO noise
partial or missing stages cannot be labelled COMPLETE
source/config/data/parent hashes are persisted and checked

statistics.training_seed_uncertainty: report individual seeds and spread; bootstrap is conditional on fitted seed models
statistics.p_value: paired whole-user sign-flip null distribution (exact <=16 nonzero clusters, otherwise Monte Carlo +1); exchangeability assumption
statistics.meaningful_gain: lower CI bound >=+0.002 and null p<=0.05; primary family uses Holm; secondary controls explicitly marked

repairs_v2: SFT task is the HaNoRec hit=1 binary task: true next item -> Yes, seeded random train-only unseen item -> No (50/50); hard CF negatives are DPO-only
DPO policy runs with all dropout modules at p=0 (LLaMA-Factory disable_dropout_in_model); reference is the SFT adapter only
LoRA targets language-model linear layers only; vision tower and merger frozen (LLaMA-Factory freeze_vision_tower=True)
candidate score ties keep the frozen SASRec order instead of item-id order
SFT micro-batch 2 x accumulation 8 follows train/mllm_sft.sh
native bf16 is required by the original protocol; Kaggle serves only T4/P100 (bf16 emulated on T4) so this is recorded as an adaptation, not enforced

SFT uses both a Yes and a No sample per training pair (2x examples/epoch vs upstream's one randomly-labelled sample per row); epochs and max_pixels are derived from measured T4 speed/VRAM and recorded as adaptations
repairs_v3: Hash-pinned source CSV, verified CSV item IDs +1 equals downstream row sequence. User identifiers pseudonymized.
Negatives exclude every TRAIN-known item of the same true user, including history outside the 10-item window. Never consult held-out labels.
Prediction event IDs stay stable; cluster_id carries true-user grouping. Cluster bootstrap and paired null permutation replace row-independent inference.
Historical repaired SFT v2/DPO arms v1 remain immutable and mechanism-ineligible due to known-positive negatives.
